description: This file defines functions and classes for efficient lookup of strings within a fixed set using a DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). It includes functions for string and suffix lookup, and a class for incremental prefix/suffix queries.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: Provides incremental, space-efficient membership and prefix queries against a fixed set of strings represented as a DAFSA.

methods.name: LookupStringInFixedSet
methods.description: Performs a fast lookup to determine if a string is in a fixed set, returning a code indicating presence and rule type.

methods.name: LookupSuffixInReversedSet
methods.description: Finds the longest matching suffix in a reversed DAFSA for a given host string.

methods.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lookup with a graph; supports incremental character addition and result retrieval.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Adds a character to the current input sequence for prefix/suffix matching.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Returns the match result code for the current input sequence.
